system.body: EXIOR does not add another disconnected tool. It creates a decision and execution layer across the systems you already use, then builds only the capabilities that create measurable value.

engine.headline: Internal performance and external intelligence, continuously reconciled.
engine.body: EXIOR connects what is happening inside the agency with what is changing outside it. The system detects opportunities and constraints, ranks them by expected value, and turns the highest-priority decisions into working capabilities.

faq.q: What is included in the US$500 installation?
faq.a: The initial operating model, private workspace, core dashboards and intelligence layers, first integrations where technically available, and a prioritized 30/90-day execution roadmap.

A first working version of the system once the required information and access are available. Scope is prioritized around the highest-value capabilities that can be implemented reliably within the initial installation.

faq.q: Do we need to replace our existing tools?
faq.a: No. EXIOR is designed to work around the systems you already use and only introduces new components where they create a clear operational advantage.

faq.q: Can EXIOR build custom automations and internal systems?
faq.a: Yes. Dashboards, integrations, agents and workflows are selected according to expected business value and technical feasibility.

faq.q: What happens after the initial installation?
faq.a: You can keep the installed system and operate it internally, or extend EXIOR into continuous monitoring, prioritization and execution.
